subject: SLO evidence & dashboard access — procurement audit
messages:
From: Alyssa Moore <procurement@globex.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <it-security@globex.com>
Date: 2026-04-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SLO evidence + metrics access for procurement/security review

Hi Vanessa,

We're kicking off a procurement review for our planned Redwood integration and need to validate your uptime/latency commitments and monitoring approach before legal signs off. Specifically, can you provide:

- A short evidence pack that defines your SLOs (availability & p50/p95/p99 latency) and how they are measured (aggregation window, success criteria).
- Details on monitoring, alerting (on-call, pager thresholds), and the escalation process for SLO breaches.
- Whether we can get read-only access to a metrics dashboard (Grafana/Prometheus) or a time-limited API token to pull historical metrics covering the last 12 months.
- Any exceptions/process for retention or historical export if longer retention is necessary for audits.

We'd like to have the materials by EOD Friday so our security/ procurement teams can proceed. Attaching our standard SLO checklist for reference.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Moore
Procurement Manager, Globex Corp
[Attachment: globex_slo_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24 KB)]
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Moore <procurement@globex.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <it-security@globex.com>
Date: 2026-04-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SLO evidence + metrics access for procurement/security review

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for the checklist and the clear ask. Summary below and attachments included. Happy to set up a short demo of the dashboard if helpful.

Quick answers:
- SLO definitions: Our production SLOs are 99.9% availability (monthly window) and p95/p99 latency targets vary by model class; example: text-generation (p95 < 350ms, p99 < 750ms) when served on our Dedicated nodes. See attached redwood_slo_bsr_2026.pdf for the full table and measured baselines.
- Measurement/aggregation: We measure success per-customer route via a 30-day rolling window and compute availability as successful model responses / total requests (2xx tokenized responses). Latency percentiles are calculated on response completion time excluding streaming overhead.
- Monitoring & alerting: Primary stack is Prometheus + Grafana + Alertmanager. Alerts are tiered: SLO burn-rate alerts (warning at 2x burn, critical at 5x), and operational thresholds for tail latency. On-call rotation (SRE) follows a 24x7 pager with documented escalation to product lead and CTO for sustained incidents.
- Dashboard & access: We can provide a read-only Grafana link (time-limited) and a scoped API token for pull access. For security, dashboard links are behind our SSO and we issue short-lived links + role-based tokens. The shared dashboard will include the last 90 days by default; historical exports can be provided on request.

Two policy notes for clarity:
1) Standard retention for ready-to-view metrics is 90 days. We do retain higher-fidelity internal telemetry longer for root-cause and compliance, but customer-facing dashboards default to 90 days.
2) Exceptional retention (12 months) is possible but requires procurement approval and a limited-data-export exception due to storage and compliance controls — we flag this as a contract-level exception.

Next steps I propose:
- I will share a read-only dashboard link and a short evidence pack (attached) now.
- If Globex requires 12-month historical retention, please send a formal exception request and we'll route it through platform compliance (I can lead that).
- Offer: 30-minute walkthrough with SRE + PM this week if you want to review alerts and on-call flow.

Attachments:
- redwood_slo_bsr_2026.pdf [Attachment: Redwood SLO baseline & measurement methodology (PDF, 412 KB)]
- metrics-dashboard-screenshot.png [Attachment: sample Grafana dashboard (PNG, 128 KB)]

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-20T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: SLO evidence + metrics access for procurement/security review

Team — forwarding Globex's request and my reply. Short summary and asks for approvals: 

Summary of external asks:
- Provide SLO definitions + evidence pack (done, attached).
- Read-only access to metrics dashboard + API token (we can supply).
- Historical metrics for 12 months (they requested) — our default is 90 days.

Proposal:
- Grant Globex a time-limited read-only Grafana link (2 weeks) and a scoped API token for pull access to aggregated metrics.
- Offer a 30-minute walkthrough with SRE and PM (Vanessa + SRE) to explain alerting and escalation flows.
- If they insist on 12-month retention, request procurement-level exception: I will submit an exception doc (attached) and need approval to proceed. This may take 5–10 business days and could impact pricing due to storage/compliance handling.

Please review the attached exception request (slo-retention-exception-request.docx) — key questions for legal/compliance: allowed retention, redaction rules for PII in logs, and whether we can limit exported granularity (e.g., daily aggregates only).

Cc'ing Marcus for finance/discount contingency: if we need to offer a retention-related credit or one-time export fee, advise on the allowance.

Thanks — want to get Globex a clean yes by Friday.

— Vanessa
From: Alyssa Moore <procurement@globex.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <it-security@globex.com>
Date: 2026-04-21T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SLO evidence & dashboard access — procurement audit

Vanessa — thanks for the quick response and the attachments, that helps a lot. A few follow-ups and confirmations before we move to legal:

- The read-only Grafana link and scoped API token are acceptable as a first step. Please send the link and token with the limited access scope.
- For the 12-month retention ask: Globex compliance requires 12 months for vendor telemetry for auditability. We accept the exception process you outlined; please submit the exception and include proposed contractual language that limits Redwood's exposure (e.g., \"retention for audit purposes only; data exported as aggregated daily metrics; no raw request-level logs\").
- Can you provide a suggested SLA clause for the retention exception and any price/credit? We need this to show our legal team before the DocuSign step.

If you can provide the dashboard link and a draft DocuSign with the suggested retention clause by EOD tomorrow, we can queue this into our legal sprint. Also please provide a direct escalation contact (name and phone) for availability incidents.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Moore
Procurement Manager, Globex Corp
[Preferred contact: alyssa.moore@globex.com | +1 (617) 555-0123]
